item.title: Why is this 15 year old still in Morocco and not in some big company?
item.summary: So this kid (https://youtu.be/sYEOMAf2S64) (https://github.com/deadbeef7) made waves a few years ago after he participated in google devfest 2022, but he still lives in Morocco, no companies ever talked to him TALENT IS BEING LOST RIGHT IN FRONT OF YOUR EYES Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49330782 Points: 4 # Comments: 4
